Feels silly to leave a review on a game so well known as this, but gotta let CA know I appreciate his attitude towards fans. 

Lots of replayability because you can decide if you want to prioritize money, friendships, or resources at the start of your run as well as farm layouts, marriage options, pets/farm animals, etc. 

It's no secret that a lot of us hate the fishing mechanic so it would be nice if there was an option to adjust it outside of rod and equipment purchases. However there is a way to get to level 5 fishing without fishing much or using mods.

Community Center Completion tip: [spoiler]I complete bundles the best I can/want to for easy rewards/farm help and then purchase the joja membership and pay to complete the remaining ones (it's the fish tank lets be honest). Membership fee is still the same but you only have to pay to complete bundles you haven't already completed so the overall cost is much less than if purchased from the beginning. It will no longer be a community center but a joja mart warehouse or whatever, so be sure to consider that. [/spoiler]

Mastering Fishing: [spoiler]Use the crab pots and just fish wherever it's easiest for you to do so. Better rods and bait/bobbers are available eventually to help further. The REAL way to quickly do this is read books. The fishing books help obviously BUT there are a handful of books that will send xp points to other skills if the main skill it's meant to benefit is maxed. I mastered fishing this way within 4years without prioritizing it. Bookseller and traveling cart merchant are where to go. [/spoiler]

Pretty much anything else can be modded and CA has always openly supported the mod community. I recommend playing without mods as long as possible to best understand the game as many popular mods add a lot of new content and it can be overwhelming for new players.
